name: CADaddy Public MEP Cost Data
description: Public-domain and openly licensed cost data for MEP estimating. Ships with CADaddy. Every row cites its source, licence and status (seed or fetched); every row today is a seed placeholder. ELECTRICAL LABOR IS EXCLUDED (private company pack only).

p405.title: NAVFAC P-405 Seabee Planner's and Estimator's Handbook
p405.publisher: US Navy, Naval Facilities Engineering Command
p405.distribution: Distribution Statement A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.
p405.note: Military-crew baseline, 1996. Man-hours reflect Seabee crew experience and conditions — calibrate to commercial crews and current productivity.

bls_oews.title: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
bls_oews.note: Annual mean wages by metropolitan area and occupation.

bls_ppi.title: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Producer Price Indexes
bls_ppi.note: Price indexes (not prices) for material families; use for escalation only.

davis_bacon.title: Davis-Bacon Wage Determinations
davis_bacon.publisher: US Department of Labor via SAM.gov
davis_bacon.note: Prevailing wages for federally funded construction by county and trade.

excluded.electrical_labor: Man-hours, labor units, production rates, crew productivity and labor factors for electrical work. Private company pack only.
excluded.commercial_cost_books: Any source whose terms forbid redistribution (RS Means, Craftsman, etc.).
excluded.commodity_feeds: Exchange or commodity price feeds with redistribution restrictions.

status.seed: A placeholder written for CADaddy to show the pack's shape: NOT data from the agency the row names. Its source says "seed placeholder — not from …" and its licence is CADaddy's.
status.fetched: Fetched from the named public source on the date in the row's `fetched` column (cargo xtask fetch-pubcost).
